in_sanskrit.name: सुगन्या
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: One who has good qualities, prosperity, and fortune. Derived from the Sanskrit word ‘su’ (good) and ‘ganya’ (possessing, having).

in_hindi.name: सुगन्या
in_hindi.long_meaning: Suganya is a name of Indian origin, derived from the Sanskrit language. In Hindi, the name is pronounced as ‘सुगन्या’ (Suganya). It is a combination of the Sanskrit words ‘su’ (good) and ‘ganya’ (having). The name is often interpreted to mean ‘one who has good qualities, prosperity, and fortune.’

in_tamil.name: சுகந்யா

in_marathi.name: Suganya
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Granting Desires, Pleasing
in_marathi.long_meaning: Suganya हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Suganya means 'granting desires, pleasing'. It is also the name of a goddess in Hinduism, who is believed to fulfill the desires of her devotees.
